page.layout: Running head at top, centred: "ORIGO ET PROGRESSVS." with page number "261" at top right. Above the caption, the engraved oval portrait with its inscription running round the oval (left side and right side). Below the portrait, one four-line verse caption at left. "R 3" as a signature at the foot, right of the caption.

main_text.head: IOAN[illegible, ~6 letters]VS PRINC. FRANCÆ-VILLÆ, GVB. GENERALIS IN BELGIO
main_text.p: Genitore clarus Cæsare; ast insignior Victoria, æquum sustuli cælo caput, Victo hoste Turca. Belgicæ dantem inga[?] Mortalium avidum pestis abstulit malum.

page.notes: The page is mainly an engraved oval portrait of a man in profile, with a ruff and armour, set in an oval border. The inscription around the oval is partly hidden and partly illegible on the left side, so the start of the name is not read. The verse caption has a doubtful word in line 3 ("inga"), marked [?]. Long s is given as plain s throughout. The R 3 mark is a gathering signature.
